questions.question:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

1, 8, 29, 92, 281, ?
questions.solution:
According to the given series:

1st term = 1

2ⁿd term = 1 + 7 × 3⁰ = 8

3rd term = 8 + 7 × 3¹ = 29

4th term = 29 + 7 × 3² = 92

5th term = 92 + 7 × 3³ = 281

So, the 6th term = 281 + 7 × 3⁴ = 848

Hence, the correct answer is 848.

questions.question:

questions.solution:
According to the given series:

1st term = 2

2ⁿd term = 2 + 5 × 3⁰ = 7

3rd term = 7 + 5 × 3¹ = 22

4th term = 22 + 5 × 3² = 67

So, 5th term = 67 + 5 × 3³ = 202

Hence, 202 is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a row of cars Maruti is 20th from the left end of row. Honda is 10th to the right from Maruti and is at the exact center of row. How many cars are there in the row?
questions.solution:
According to the given information:

Maruti = 20th from the left end.

Honda = 10th to the right from Maruti means it is 30th from the left end row = exact Centre of the row.

If the 30th car is exactly at the centre, then total number of cars will be = 29 cars from left side + 29 cars from right side + 30th car i.e. 29 + 29 + 1 = 59

Hence, total number of cars in the row are 59.

questions.question: Abhinav started running from his house, he first ran for 12 km towards west, then he turned towards north and ran 16 km in that direction. How far Abhinav is from his house and in which direction?
questions.solution:
According to the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75769695e62bb156f97218a789574b8d991aca5c193a4deaf8055559e9f0bfa2.png] 

The distance can be calculated using Pythagoras theorem as:

Distance from his home = (16² +12²)¹/² = (256 + 144)¹/² = 20 km

Hence, Abhinav is 20 km far in Northwest direction from his house.
